title: Daylight Saving in Aotearoa: Three Clock Futures
blurb: Is NZ really scrapping daylight saving? An interactive regional map of three clock policies — keep, abolish, permanent NZDT — with health, safety and energy evidence weighed honestly (14 citations verified, none retracted).
source: scripts/compute_dst_data.py + scripts/simplify_dst_geojson.py in this repo; Stats NZ regional boundaries (CC-BY 4.0) and subnational population estimates
